messages:
dara: opening PR to refresh SDK examples1: streaming now emits chunk events, list APIs use cursor, and add a tiny resume+jitter pattern. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4899

rajesh: thanks. Can we show a minimal Python assembly pattern (users keep expecting a single payload)? small snippet is fine.

dara: yep. plan: async iterator canonical + a one-liner sync wrapper for demos.

kelly: for Go please include ctx cancel/timeouts in examples. Our integration tests saw goroutine leaks from old examples.

infra-bot: examples-lint queued for PR 4899. reviewers requested: @rajesh @kelly.

rajesh: python example proposal:```py
parts = []
async for ev in client.stream(req):
    if ev.type == "delta":
        parts.append(ev.text)
    elif ev.type == "error":
        raise RuntimeError(ev.message)
result = "".join(parts)
```
callout: show how to persist resume_token events if present.

kelly: Go snippet idea:```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
defer cancel()
stream, err := client.Stream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { return err }
for {
  ev, err := stream.Recv()
  if err == io.EOF { break }
  if err != nil { /* classify and maybe backoff */ }
  if ev.Type == "delta" { buf += ev.Text }
}
```
note: import context,time,io. Also recommend checking stream.Err() where available.

kelly: i'll push a tiny fix to a helper that still used page_token.

rajesh: TS snippet:```ts
let buf = ''
for await (const ev of client.stream(req)) {
  if (ev.type === 'delta') buf += ev.text
  if (ev.type === 'resume_token') save(ev.token)
}
```
callout: mention Node >=12 for for-await-of and polyfill options for older runtimes.

dara: adding an advanced pattern: resume-token + exponential jitter backoff (language-agnostic outline) and a concrete py/ts helper. It shows max attempts and randomized sleep.

rajesh: small doc nit: we renamed page_token -> cursor in API; confirm all SDK examples switched. I grep'ed and found one Go helper which kelly fixed.

infra-bot: examples-sanity passed for docs#4899. docs-build queued.

kelly: pushed small wording about batching 1: "larger batches can reduce cost but may raise p99 latency" and a short tip when to prefer smaller batches.

docs-bot: PR opened: docs#4899  reviewers: @rajesh @kelly. CI: examples-lint/examples-sanity/docs-build.

dara: thanks all. Plan: merge after CI, then add a brief migration note in breaking-changes.md that shows old vs new snippets (iterator + cursor rename). Ill ping support to update runbooks. Ping here if you spot any lingering page_token references or odd wording. :slightly_smiling_face:
